line: A hunch shows up mid-meeting. Note it down and test it before you share it.
Someone offers help today. Say yes, then buy them a kopi after.
Your inbox gets loud today. Clear the hardest one first, then breathe.

A side chance pops up today. Ask the real cost before you say yes.
Good day to sort the bills. Boring work, very nice feeling after.
Your fun side wins today. Book the makan plan; the spreadsheet can wait.
